source: StatsBomb Open Data and HuffPost / Opta
coverageNote: World Cup samples cover 26 of 64 matches in 2014, 30 of 64 in 2018, and 33 of 64 in 2022. Copa America 2024 and UEFA Euro 2024 remain as supplementary samples. 2014 profiles identify HuffPost / Opta; other editions use StatsBomb. Providers record different action sets.

additionalSources.coordinateSystem: Opta x0 own goal line, x100 opponent goal line in every period and team; y0 bottom and y100 top. Canonical x=source.x and y=100-source.y. Reject out-of-bounds; do not clamp or rotate by side/period.
additionalSources.passCompletion: Type1 outcome1 complete, outcome0 incomplete, other unknown. Type2 offside pass is incomplete regardless of outcome.
additionalSources.onTarget: 13 Miss and 14 Post false. 16 Goal without own-goal qualifier28 true. 15 Attempt Saved with qualifier82 false; all sampled type15 lack82 because HuffPost omits it, so onTarget=null and goal=false. All shots remain in goals/shots; on-target denominator uses knownTargetShots only.
additionalSources.comparability: Providers annotate different event sets. Opta retained actions and StatsBomb (including Carry/Ball Receipt) are not equal event-volume measures; do not rank ability by combined raw action counts.
additionalSources.identity: Only provider event.id is used, namespaced huffpost:<matchId>:<id>. Missing id excluded; event_id is team-local, not an identity fallback. Missing-ID 100/101 derived points and102 starter markers are not observed action rows.
additionalSources.coverageNote: 26/64 author schedule matches cover every source-lineup and independent author-dataset verified 2014 appearance of the existing 12 focal longitudinal players. This is a selected tournament sample.

sourceCommitAppliesTo: StatsBomb Open Data only; HuffPost / Opta match files are pinned by individual SHA-256 values.
